policy.semantics: Exact READ_TOOLS/WRITE_TOOLS; AI write call counts regardless of missing/failed result. Workspace-resolved case-sensitive paths and original parameter precedence/range behavior. Writes processed before reads in one source row, so only later rows invalidate. Every concrete path of a read_many_files candidate must be written; any wildcard refuses candidate. Raw call ID matching is global, without provider-ID normalization; responses before and after the read are excluded from surviving recency when stale. Only targeted blocks are removed; other blocks survive. Repeated reads alone do not supersede.
policy.storage: Existing density:file-inclusions:1 shared native trie. Header generation[0:2] prefixes rw/call-id, reads/path, read/node, candidate/id, stale/ordinal/id, stale-id/id, responses/id, response/node, position/ordinal/block, bucket-id/name, bucket/id and sum/bucket/index. Existing human inclusion path keys remain separate. Read chains and survivor Fenwick sums live on disk; no history-sized path map or per-operation input/output/index files.
policy.mutation: Registered append processes added rows and affected path/response postings; structural rewrites refill survivors once. Missing readiness or changed exact revision requires fill. Old pins retain old roots; clone/compaction/reopen/clear/refill pass.
policy.nativeCallsite: ChatSession.ensureCompressionBeforeSend -> CompressionHandler.ensureDensityOptimized -> HistoryServiceCore.optimizeDensityRows -> journalDensity.optimizeDensityOnJournal -> journalNativeDensity.optimizeNativeDensity -> nativeRecencyPolicy/nativeReadWrite -> existing detached native writer with raw source ordinal.
policy.remainingEdge: Existing duplicate same-ID AI calls with no substantive surviving text can produce an empty array-policy replacement that native admission refuses. Grouped-ID fixture retains substantive text. No admission rule or old policy was changed; this edge remains open.

measurements.cacheBoundary: Encoded node bytes plus fixed entry/key overhead, not total path-string/pin/cache capacity.
measurements.lifetimeBoundary: Selected fact arrays and actual sink output objects at awaited backpressure, unchanged bound two; not whole heap/string bytes or capacity. Cold fill and selected reads reported separately. Pin acquisition and initial append are outside selected query interval.
